name: Oakey Landing
summary: Oakey Landing is a commercial property located in Hudson Oaks, Texas, offering retail and commercial leasing opportunities in the growing Fort Worth metropolitan area. The center serves the expanding residential communities of Parker County with convenient access along Oakey Trail.
demographics: Oakey Landing serves the Hudson Oaks community and surrounding Parker County area, which attracts primarily middle to upper-middle income families drawn to the region's suburban lifestyle and proximity to Fort Worth. The trade area consists largely of homeowners in the 30-55 age range with household incomes above the Texas median, including young professionals and established families seeking quality schools and a small-town atmosphere with big-city access. Shopping patterns reflect convenience-oriented needs with residents valuing local accessibility for everyday services while maintaining proximity to larger retail destinations in Fort Worth for major shopping trips.
description: Oakey Landing is a commercial property located at 3017 Oakey Trail in Hudson Oaks, Texas, a growing community in the Fort Worth metropolitan area. This property represents a leasing opportunity in the Parker County region, strategically positioned to serve the residential communities of Hudson Oaks and surrounding areas. The center is situated along Oakey Trail, providing convenient access for local residents and commuters traveling through this developing corridor west of Fort Worth. As Hudson Oaks continues to experience growth and development, Oakey Landing offers retail and commercial space in a market with expanding demographics and increasing household incomes. The property maintains operating hours from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, accommodating both daytime and evening customer traffic patterns typical of suburban commercial developments.
